messages:
sophia: Heads-up — I'm drafting the launch checklist for the Visibility work (dashboards + tracing hooks + cost breakdown + error analytics). Want to capture scope decisions here so we can lock for an initial beta. Customer asks: Acme and FinSecure want per-route cost breakdown and span-level error links. Can we triage what must be in v1 vs v1+.

mike: +1. My quick take: v1 must include dashboard templates (overview + per-model cost), trace hooks with low-overhead sampling, and a basic error analytics page that links to traces. Per-route cost (per API route) can be MVP but per-span cost should be v1+.

raj: Technical note — for tracing hooks we measured ~1.2-1.8ms p50 overhead on our dev images with continuous batching enabled. That increases with full sampled traces. We should default to 5% sampling for production traffic, 100% for dev. Also need to standardize span tags: route, model_id, quantization_profile.

elaine: Launch criteria proposal: 1) Dashboard templates implemented + default installs for new orgs; 2) Trace hooks instrumented in hosted API + Dedicated SDK docs; 3) Cost breakdown available at route-level with token and compute split; 4) Error analytics shows top-10 errors and links to traces; 5) E2E smoke tests + basic perf guardrail (<2ms added p50). Anything else?

mike: One more: rollout plan + feature flagging per org. Default OFF for orgs with >100k req/day until we can validate perf. Also add a flag for retention window: 30d default, 90d enterprise.

raj: Agree on flags. For config we can expose something like:

```
observability:
  traces:
    sampling_rate: 0.05
    extra_tags: ["route","model_id","quant_profile"]
  retention_days: 30
  cost_breakdown: ["route","model","tokens","gpu_ms"]
```

This keeps runtime checks cheap. If product wants per-span costing, we need an aggregation pipeline change (v1+).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: note — perf test run 2026-03-19 04:12 shows 1.5ms avg trace overhead at 5% sampling for latest trace-hook branch.

sophia: Thanks all. Decisions proposed (please react): :one: Default retention 30d (enterprise opt-in 90d) :two: Sampling default 5% :three: Per-route cost in v1, per-span costing v1+ :four: Dashboard templates + error analytics in v1.

elaine: :thumbsup: — will add these to the PRD and surface any customer blockers.

mike: :thumbsup: on 30d/5% and flags. I'll own rollout gating.

raj: :thinking_face: I'll add span tag guidelines and a lightweight SDK shim to reduce vector allocations.

sophia: Great. Follow-up items — (a) product to finalize PRD by EOD Thu, (b) eng to add perf smoke to CI, (c) biz/devex to draft customer comms for beta. We'll sync Thursday standup if there are blockers.
